tab.label: Overview
tab.content: TYPO3 is a free and open-source enterprise Content Management System. It provides a stable and reliable foundation for building websites of all sizes.

tab.label: Features
tab.content: Inlinefluid lets editors write Fluid templates directly in the TYPO3 backend — no sitepackage deployment needed for simple rendering tasks.

tab.label: Contact
tab.content: For support and questions please visit the TYPO3 Slack workspace or open an issue in the extension repository.
